content: Bɛkɩklɩ́ Yesu Nwunsʋ
Israelfɔ Bodobodo Mátúhɛ́Nkɛ, igyi amʋ́sʋ́ Katsʋn Nkɛ ámʋ gyí ɩbá bɔfʋn.
Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ amʋ bodunká ɔkpa ánɩ́ bɔ́tsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ kɩ́tá Yesu ŋáintɔ, mɔ́ mʋ, tsúfɛ́ bʋdɛ ahá ámʋ ifú nya.
Yuda Iskariot Lótsulá Ánɩ́ Ɔbɛ́lɛ Yesu Há
Ɩnʋ Ɔbʋnsám lówie Yuda Iskariot, ogyi Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛtɔ.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɔyɔ Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa agyópʋ dɛhɛn wá, bɛkɩtá agywɩɩn alɩá ɔbɛ́lɛ Yesu há amʋ́.
Ansɩ́ légyi amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ botsulá ánɩ́ bɛ́ka mʋ ɩkɔ.
Yuda lótsulá. Mʋ́ sʋ olodunká ɔkpa ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́tsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ hɩ́ɛ́ɛ́ lɛ́ Yesu há amʋ́, brɛ́á ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ ámʋ bʋma ɩnʋ.
Katsʋn Atogyihɛ Gyí
Bodobodo Mátúhɛ́Nkɛ ámʋtɔ ɛkɛá bʋtɔmɔ́ Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ akúfa lɔfʋn.
Yesu lɔ́wa Petro mʋa Yohane ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋyɔ́bwɛ Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn atogyihɛ amʋ yaɩ ha amʋ́.
Petro mʋa Yohane bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíé, nkʋ́nʋ ayɔ́bwɛ mʋ́ yaɩ?”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ mlowíé wúlu ɔnɔ́ á, mléfia oyin ɔkʋá ɔsʋ ntsu-ɔlɔ́. Mlɩbuo mʋ yɔ wóyítɔ́.
Mlowíé á, mlɩfɩtɛ wóyí mʋ wie amʋ mlɩaa, ‘Osunápʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, afɩ́tɛ fʋ́, nkʋ́nʋ afɔɔ́ ɔswɩɩ́kpá bʋ, ánɩ́ mɩ́a mɩ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ abɛ́ba begyi Katsʋn atogyihɛ amʋ?’
Obósuná mlɩ abansʋ́rʋ yílé kʋá balá mʋ́tɔ́ yáɩ́. Mlɩbwɛ atɔ́ ámʋ yaɩ ɩnʋ.”
Petro mʋa Yohane bɔpʋ ɔkpa. Boyówun tógyítɔ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ámʋ pɛ́pɛ́ɛ́pɛ́, bɔbwɛ Katsʋn atogyihɛ amʋ yáɩ́ ɩnʋ.
Yesu Ntʋ́pwɛ Atogyihɛ Tráhɛ
Atɔ́ ámʋ gyíbɩ lɔfʋn, Yesu mʋa mʋ sumbí ayɔpʋ́ bɛba betsiá ɔpʋ́nʋ́ ámʋ asɩ.
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nhɩ́ɛ́ ndeklé mbɛ́ɛ, mɩ́a mlɩnyɔ abégyi Katsʋn Nkɛtɔ atogyihɛ anfɩ asa mɩ́ anwun ɩwɩɔsɩn.
Tsúfɛ́ ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, mmɛ́ɛtrá gyi mʋ́ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá ɩtɔ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ atogyihɛ anfɩ ɩlɩɩ́ há ámʋ laba mʋ́tɔ́ Bulu iwíegyí amʋtɔ.”
Ɩnʋ olotsu ntá-ɛwɛ, dá Bulu ɩpán, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩhɔ amlɩnu ha aba.
Tsúfɛ́ ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, mmɛ́ɛtrá nu wáɩn-abí ntá ánfɩ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ yɔ́fʋn brɛ́á Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɩbɛ́ba.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛlɛ bodobodo ipín, ɔlɛda Bulu ɩpán, bíábía mʋ́tɔ́ pʋ́há amʋ́, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ ɔyʋlʋ́á mlɩ sʋ nasí há nɩ́. Mlɩtsia bwɛ ɩ́nɩ pʋkaɩn mɩ́sʋ́.”
Alɩ kɛ́n, brɛ́á begyi atɔ́ ámʋ tá á, olotsu ntá-ɛwɛ ámʋ há amʋ́, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntá-ɛwɛ ánfɩ gyí Bulu ntam pɔpwɛ ánɩ́ nɛ́tsɛɩ́ mɩ́ obugya wʋ́lɩ́ pʋ́sí mʋ́sʋ́ há mlɩ nɩ́.
“Ɩ́nɩá ndɛblɩ́ á, mɩ́a ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há ámʋ ɩbɩ da ɔlɛpɛ ɔkʋlɛtɔ.
Mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nówu fɛ́ alɩá Bulu lɛ́hɩɛ yáɩ́, támɛ ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há ámʋ ɔgyɔ́wɩ.”
Ɩnʋ befi asɩ bʋdɛ aba fɩtɛ́ bɛɛ, “Ngya anɩtɔ ma ɔbɔ́bwɛ ɩ́nɩ?”
Ma Ɔbɔ́bwɛ Ɔhandɛ?
Nwɛ́ɛngyí lɛ́ba sumbí ayɔpʋ́ ámʋtɔ, amʋ́tɔ́ ɔmʋá ɔbɔ́bwɛ ɔhandɛ sʋ.
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔmátɔ́fɔ awíe bʋbʋ túmi amʋ́ ahásʋ. Ahá ámʋ bʋtɛtɩ́ amʋ́ ahandɛ bɛɛ, ‘Bʋalɛ agyípʋ́.’
Támɛ mlɩtɔ mʋ́ á, ɩmába alɩ. Ɔhá ánɩ́ odekléá ɔbɔ́bwɛ mlɩtɔ ɔhandɛ ɔbwɛ́ɛ mʋ ɩwɩ ɔtráhɛ. Ɔhá ánɩ́ odeklé ɔbɛ́ɛ, mɔ́bwɛ mlɩ nkpá ogyápʋ ɛ́ ɔbwɛ́ɛ mʋ ɩwɩ fɛ́ osúmpʋ́.
Ma dʋ́n mʋ ba? Ɔhá ánɩ́ otsie ɔpʋ́nʋ́asɩ lóó, ntɛ́ɛ ɔhá ánɩ́ odesúm ɔpʋ́nʋ́ ámʋ asɩ? Megyí ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ otsie mʋ́ asɩ ámʋ dʋn? Támɛ mbʋ mlɩtɔ fɛ́ osúmpʋ́.
“Mlɩlɔ́wa klʋn buo mɩ mɩ́ ɩsɔ́kɩ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́ nɩ.
Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ mɩ́ Sɩ́ layáɩ́ mɩ́ owíe amʋ a, alɩ́ mɩ́ ɛ́ ndɛ mlɩ yaɩ́ nɩ́,
mɛ́nɩ mlétsiá mɩ́ ɔpʋ́nʋ́asɩ, gyi atɔ́, nú ntá mɩ́ iwíe ogyíkpá ɩnʋ. Mlétsiá awíe mbíásʋ́, gyi Israel abusuan dúanyɔ ámʋ asʋ́n.”
Petro Ɔbɔ́swɩɩ́ Ɔbɛ́ɛ Mʋmeyín Yesu
Yesu lɛ́bláa Simon Petro ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Simon, Simon! Kɩ, Ɔbʋnsám dɛ́ ɔkpa kʋlɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, obófuní mlɩ fɛ́ ayó.
Támɛ nakókóli Bulu há fʋ́ mbɛ́ɛ, fʋmádɩda hógyitɔ. Nɩ́ feyínkí ba mɩ́ wá á, wa fʋ́ aba ámʋ ɛ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n.”
Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé natsúlá, nɩ́ obu igyi kʋ́ráá mɩ́a fʋnyɔ abɛ́dɩ. Nɩ́ lowu ígyi ɛ́ á, mɩ́a fʋnyɔ abówu.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Petro, ndɛ fʋ́ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, ndɛ, asa batɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ ɔnɔ́ á, fɔ́swɩɩ́ pʋ́ ɩbɩ wá ogyá tse sa fɛɛ fʋmeyín mɩ́.”
Ɩwɩklɩ́ Ánɩ́ Ɩbɛ́ba Ɛkɛkʋ́
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Brɛ́á nɔwa mlɩ sumbí, mlɩmɛ́dɛ́ sika akɛntɛ, mlɩmɛ́dɛ́ akpankogyo ntɛ́ɛ ntʋkʋta nyɔɔsɩ a, tɔkʋ lehián mlɩ?” Bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Tɔtɔ mehián anɩ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Támɛ séi mʋ́ á, fʋ́á fʋ́bʋ sika kɛntɛ, ntɛ́ɛ akpankogyo a, tsu kɩta. Nɩ́ mlɩtɔ ɔkʋ má ɔdayí ɩya anyɔ á, ɔfɛ́ mʋ tati pʋhɔ kʋ!

Tsúfɛ́ ilehián ánɩ́ mɩ́ ɩwɩ asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́tɔ ámʋ ɩbɛ́ba mʋ́tɔ́. Bɔwanlɩ́n bɛɛ, ‘Bɛkla mʋ wá lakpan abwɛpʋ́tɔ́.’ Tsúfɛ́ asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ bɔwanlɩ́n tsú mɩ́ ɩwɩ ámʋ ɩbá lafʋn ta.”
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíe, kɩ, ndayí anyɔ nɩ́.” Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩtsɔ.”
Mpáɩbɔ Nfɔ-nyíbʋsʋ
Yesu lɛ́dalɩ wúlutɔ yɔ́ Nfɔ-nyíbʋ ámʋsʋ, fɛ́ alɩá otetsíá yɔ́ ɩnʋ yáɩ́. Mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ ɛ́ bobuo mʋ.
Brɛ́á bowie ɩnʋ á, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩkokoli Bulu, mɛ́nɩ mlɩmóowie ɩsɔ́kɩtɔ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛdalɩ amʋ́tɔ́ yɔ́ nkpá kpalobí fɛ́ nfɩ mʋ́a nfɩ, yɛ́da akpawunu bɔ́ mpáɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Mɩ́ Sɩ́, nɩ́ fótsulá á, ha ntá-ɛwɛ ánfɩ
ɩtsʋn mɩsʋ. Támɛ megyí tɔ́á ndeklé, mʋ́a fʋdeklé ɩbá mʋ́tɔ́.”
Ɩnʋ Bulu-ɔbɔpʋ lótsu ɔsʋ́sʋ́ bá bɛlɛ ɩwɩ ɔwan súná mʋ, wá mʋ ɔwʋnlɩ́n.
Asʋ́n ɩhɩ́ɛ́ dɛ mʋ háan. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɔbɔ mpáɩ kínkíínkín. Ɩlɛha mʋ apípi lemlí fɛ́ obugya, ɩdɛtɩ́ɩn da ɔsʋlʋ́tɔ ta-ta-ta.
Brɛ́á ɔlɔkʋsʋ́ tsú mpáɩ ámʋ ɔbɔkpá, yínkí ba akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ wá á, olowun ánɩ́ bʋdɛdɩdɩ. Awɩrɛhɔ dɛ amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɩwɩ lawú amʋ́.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩdɛ́dɩdɩ? Mlɩkʋsʋ amlɩkokoli Bulu, mɛ́nɩ mlɩmóowie ɩsɔ́kɩtɔ.”
Yesu Kɩtá
Yesu ɔnɔ́ mesi, ɔdɔm bowotií amʋ́sʋ́. Akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Yuda gyá amʋ́ nkpá. Ɩnʋ ɔlɛnatɩ́ tʋ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, amʋlata mʋ puta,
támɛ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Yuda, latá fɛ́latá mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ pútá, pʋ́lɛ́ mɩ́ há?”
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ Yesu wá ámʋ bowun tɔ́á ɩbá. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu bɛɛ, “Akɔ́ɔ amʋ́? Anɩbʋ ndayí.”
Ɩnʋ amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋlɛ lɔ́tswɩ mʋ ɔdayí kpá Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn osúmpʋ́ ɔkʋ gyɔpɩ-ɩsʋ lɛ́.
Yesu lɛ́bláa ɔkasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mábwɛ! Isíi mlɩ ɔka!” Ɩnʋ ɔlɔpʋ ɩbɩ da osúmpʋ́ amʋ ɩsʋ ámʋ, ileyinkí tsá.

Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn, Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa agyópʋ ahandɛ pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ́ʋ́ bɛba mʋ ɔkɩtákpá amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ogyo otswapʋ́ ngyi, sʋ́ mlɩlatsú nkpotí pʋ́ ndayí mlɛbá mɩ́ ɔkɩtákpá?
Ntsie mlɩ wá Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ekekegyíɛkɛ, mlɩmɔ́pʋ ɩbɩ da mɩ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ. Támɛ mlɩ brɛ́ nɩ́, oklún túmi dɛ́ iwíe gyí.”
Petro Lɔ́swɩɩ́ Ɔbɛ́ɛ Mʋmeyín Yesu
Ɩnʋ ahá ámʋ bɛkɩtá Yesu, kpá mʋ ya Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn wóyítɔ́. Petro lɛ́pɛtɩ́ obuo amʋ́ ɔma tsútsúútsú.
Támɛ brɛ́á bosun agyabi wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ, bʋtsie mʋ́ asɩ á, Petro léyétsiá amʋ́ wá.
Otsibi ɔkʋá ogyi osúmpʋ́ ɩnʋ lówun ánɩ́ Petro tsie ogyá ámʋ asɩ, ɔlɛkɩ mʋ díín, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Oyin ánfɩ ɛ́ buo Yesu!”
Támɛ Petro lɔ́pʋ ɔnɔlɩ́ blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔtsɩ, mmeyín mʋ ɔtɩnɛtɩnɛ!”
Ɩlɔbwɛ kpalobí á, ɔha ɔkʋ ɛ́ lówun Petro, ɔlɛbláa Petro ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́ ɛ́ fʋ́bʋ amʋ́tɔ́.” Támɛ Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíé, megyí mɩ́ nɩ́!”
Fɛ́ dɔnhwɩ́rɩ kʋlɛ ɔma a, ɔha bambá ɛ́ lɛ́ba botsulá mʋ́sʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Lɛ́lɛ́, oyin ánfɩ ɛ́ létsiá mʋ wá, tsúfɛ́ Galileayin ogyi.”
Támɛ Petro lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Agya! Kɩ, mmeyín asʋ́n ánfɩ ɩwɩ kʋkʋ.” Petro ɔnɔ́ mesi, batɛ lɔ́bɔn.
Anɩ Wíe Yesu lɛ́damlí kɩ Petro. Ɩnʋ Petro lɛ́kaɩ́n asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ anɩ Wíe lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fɔ́swɩɩ́ tse sa fɛɛ fʋmeyín mɩ́ asa batɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ ɔnɔ́ onyenɩ.” ámʋsʋ.
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛdalɩ yɔ́ kpankpá hɩ́ɛ́ yósu.
Yesu Ahinlá Bwɛ
Yesusʋ akɩ́pʋ befi asɩ bʋdɛ mʋ ahinlá bwɛ, bʋdɛ mʋ da.
Bɔpʋ atɔ́ klɩ́ mʋ ansíbi, fɩ́tɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́, maládá fʋ́? Bla anɩ.”
Bɛkpa mʋ asiabí, bláa mʋ nyányála.
Yudafɔ Asʋ́n Agyípʋ́ Ansɩ́tɔ́ Lɩɩ́
Yudafɔ ahandɛ, Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ amʋ befia ɔyɩ kɛhɛ nyankɩ-nyankɩ, bɛbɩtɩ́a Yesu bɛlɩɩ́ amʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Bɛbláa Yesu bɛɛ, “Nɩ́ fʋ́gyí Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) a, bla anɩ.” Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ nɛbláa mlɩ kʋ́ráá, mlɩmóohogyi.
Nɩ́ nɛfɩtɛ́ mlɩ asʋankʋ ɛ́ á, mlɩmɛ́ɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́.
Támɛ tsú séi pʋ́ya a, mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nétsiá Bulu Otúmípʋ amʋ gyɔpɩsʋ.”
Amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu bɛɛ, “Mʋ́ sʋ fʋ́gyí Bulu mʋ Bi ámʋ nɩ?” Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ee, ɔnɔkwalɩ amʋ mlɩlablɩ́ á.”
Ɩnʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ aba bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ abɛ́trá dunká adansɩfɔ bámbá? Mʋ́ anɩlanú tsú mʋ onutó ɔnɔ́ á.”
